title: Each package installs, starts, and shows the build under test
description:
Source flow: REL418-QA-001

The package installs without a security warning, the app starts, and the settings window shows the version of the build under test.
postconditions:
- The package file name and size.
- The installer signature (Windows) or the `codesign` and `spctl` output
  (macOS).
- A screenshot of the settings sidebar with the version.
steps_actions:
1. "Remove Rocket.Chat from the machine if it is installed. On macOS, drag Rocket.Chat from Applications to the Trash. On Windows, use Settings > Apps. On Linux, use the package manager."
2. "Download the package for this target from the GitHub release of the build under test (see `Build under test` in the pack README). For `mas`, install the build from TestFlight instead."
3. "Install the package with the normal method for its type. dmg: open it and drag Rocket.Chat to Applications. pkg: double-click it and complete the installer. exe and msi: double-click them. appx: double-click it and click Install. AppImage: make it executable. deb, rpm, snap: install them with the package manager. tar.gz: extract it."
4. "Start Rocket.Chat from the Launchpad or Applications folder (macOS), the Start menu (Windows), or the application menu or the AppImage file (Linux)."
5. "Press Command+, on macOS or Ctrl+, on Windows and Linux. The App settings window opens. Look at the bottom of its left sidebar, under the section list."
6. "On macOS only, check the signature and the notarization of the installed app."
7. "Quit Rocket.Chat. On macOS, click the Rocket.Chat menu at the left of the menu bar, then click Quit Rocket.Chat. On Windows and Linux, click the File menu at the top left of the window, then click Quit Rocket.Chat."
steps_data:
1. "A machine with no Rocket.Chat install.
Agent: Check that `/Applications/Rocket.Chat.app` (macOS), the Apps list (Windows), or the package (`dpkg -l rocketchat`, `rpm -q rocketchat`, `snap list rocketchat`) is absent."
2. "`gh release download <build under test> -p '<pattern>' -D <new empty folder>`. Patterns: `*-mac.dmg`, `*-mac.pkg`, `*-win-x64.exe` (or `-ia32`, `-arm64`, or the universal `*-win.exe`), `*-win-x64.msi`, `*-win-x64.appx`, `*.AppImage`, `*.deb`, `*.rpm`, `*.snap`, `*.tar.gz`.
Agent: Run the `gh release download` command and record the file name and size."
3. "`sudo apt install ./<file>.deb`, `sudo dnf install ./<file>.rpm`, `sudo snap install --dangerous ./<file>.snap`, `chmod +x <file>.AppImage`.
Agent: Record the install output. On Windows, right-click the installer, click Properties, and open the Digital Signatures tab. Record the signer."
4. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot of the main window."
5. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot of the sidebar bottom. On macOS, run `defaults read /Applications/Rocket.Chat.app/Contents/Info.plist CFBundleShortVersionString` and expect the version of the build under test."
6. "`codesign -dv --verbose=2 /Applications/Rocket.Chat.app` and `spctl -a -vv /Applications/Rocket.Chat.app`.
Agent: Run both commands and paste the output in the evidence."
7. "None.
Agent: Check the process list (`pgrep -l Rocket.Chat` on macOS and Linux, Task Manager on Windows)."
steps_results:
1. "No Rocket.Chat app is on the machine."
2. "The file is on the disk."
3. "The install completes. macOS shows no ""cannot be opened"" or ""damaged"" message. The Windows installer shows the publisher name, not ""Unknown publisher""."
4. "The main window opens. It shows the add-workspace screen."
5. "The bottom of the sidebar shows the version of the build under test and a copyright line."
6. "`codesign` shows the Rocket.Chat Developer ID team (dmg, pkg) or the App Store identity (mas). For dmg and pkg, `spctl` shows `accepted` and `source=Notarized Developer ID`."
7. "The app closes. No Rocket.Chat process stays."

title: Installing over 4.17.4 keeps workspaces, sign-in, and settings
description:
Source flow: REL418-QA-002

After the build-under-test package installs over 4.17.4, the same workspaces open signed in and the changed settings keep their values.
postconditions:
- Screenshots of the version before and after the upgrade.
- Screenshots of the server list and the settings after the upgrade.
steps_actions:
1. "Install Rocket.Chat 4.17.4 with the same package type as this target. For `mas`, install the App Store version."
2. "Add two workspaces. On the add-workspace screen, type the first URL in the field labeled ""Enter your server URL"" and click Connect. Sign in. Then press Command+N (macOS) or Ctrl+N (Windows, Linux) to add the second workspace, and sign in."
3. "Change three settings that you can see again later. Press Command+, (macOS) or Ctrl+, (Windows, Linux). In the App settings window, change the theme in the Appearance section. In the General section, change one switch. Then move and resize the main window."
4. "Quit Rocket.Chat. On macOS, click the Rocket.Chat menu at the left of the menu bar, then click Quit Rocket.Chat. On Windows and Linux, click the File menu at the top left of the window, then click Quit Rocket.Chat."
5. "Install the build-under-test package of the same type over 4.17.4. Do not remove 4.17.4 first. For `mas`, install the TestFlight build. For AppImage, start the new AppImage file."
6. "Start Rocket.Chat."
7. "Click each workspace icon in the left vertical server list."
8. "Press Command+, (macOS) or Ctrl+, (Windows, Linux). Look at the bottom of the left sidebar, then open the sections that you changed in step 3."
steps_data:
1. "`gh release download 4.17.4 -p '<pattern>' -D <new empty folder>`. Use the patterns of REL418-QA-001, step 2.
Agent: Take a screenshot of the version."
2. "Two workspace URLs and accounts.
Agent: Record the two URLs."
3. "Theme: Dark. Note the switch name and its new value.
Agent: Take a screenshot of each changed section."
4. "None.
Agent: Check the process list."
5. "The build-under-test package from REL418-QA-001, step 2.
Agent: Record the install output."
6. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot of the main window."
7. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot of each workspace."
8. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot of the version and the settings."
steps_results:
1. "Rocket.Chat 4.17.4 starts. Press Command+, (macOS) or Ctrl+, (Windows, Linux). The bottom of the left sidebar in App settings shows `4.17.4`."
2. "The left vertical server list shows two workspace icons. Both workspaces show the signed-in home page."
3. "The settings keep the new values."
4. "No Rocket.Chat process stays."
5. "The install completes with no message about existing data."
6. "The main window opens at the same size and position as in step 3. The left vertical server list shows the same two workspaces, in the same order."
7. "Each workspace opens signed in. No sign-in page shows."
8. "The sidebar shows the version of the build under test. The theme and the switch keep the values from step 3."

title: The in-app updater moves 4.17.4 to the build under test
description:
Source flow: REL418-QA-003

4.17.4 on the Alpha channel finds the build under test, downloads it, restarts into it, and keeps the workspaces and settings.
postconditions:
- Screenshots of the update message, the dialog, and the label states.
- The version after the update.
- The main log of the updated app. macOS:
  `~/Library/Logs/Rocket.Chat/main.log`. Use Help > Open Log Viewer on all
  platforms.
steps_actions:
1. "Install Rocket.Chat 4.17.4 with this package type, add one workspace, and sign in. On the add-workspace screen, type the URL in the field labeled ""Enter your server URL"" and click Connect."
2. "Turn on Developer Mode. Click the Help menu in the menu bar (macOS) or at the top of the window (Windows, Linux). Click Developer Mode."
3. "Press Command+, (macOS) or Ctrl+, (Windows, Linux). In the left sidebar of the App settings window, click Advanced. Find the field labeled ""Update channel"" at the top of the section. Select ""Alpha (Experimental)""."
4. "In the left sidebar, click General. Click the button labeled ""Check for updates now""."
5. "In the main window, click the ""Update"" label at the right end of the top bar."
6. "Click ""Install update"". Wait for the download."
7. "Click ""Restart to update"". If the app is still open after 30 seconds, quit it from the menu. On macOS, click Rocket.Chat > Quit Rocket.Chat. On Windows and Linux, click File > Quit Rocket.Chat. Then start the app again."
8. "Press Command+, (macOS) or Ctrl+, (Windows, Linux). Look at the bottom of the left sidebar. Then click Advanced."
steps_data:
1. "`gh release download 4.17.4 -p '<pattern>' -D <new empty folder>`. Patterns: `*-mac.dmg`, `*-win.exe`, `*.AppImage`.
Agent: Take a screenshot."
2. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot of the Help menu."
3. "Channel: Alpha (Experimental).
Agent: Take a screenshot of the field."
4. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot of the message and the label."
5. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot of the dialog."
6. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot of each label state."
7. "None.
Agent: Record whether the app quit by itself, and on which OS."
8. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot of the version and the channel."
steps_results:
1. "The workspace opens signed in."
2. "Developer Mode shows a check mark the next time you open the Help menu."
3. "The field shows ""Alpha (Experimental)""."
4. "The text ""Version 4.18.0-alpha.N is available"" shows near the button, where N is the build under test. A label ""Update"" shows at the right end of the top bar of the main window."
5. "A dialog ""New version is available"" opens. It shows ""Current version"" 4.17.4 and ""New version"" equal to the build under test, with the buttons ""Install update"" and ""Skip this version""."
6. "The top bar label shows ""Updating…"" with a percentage, then ""Restart to update""."
7. "The app starts again. The workspace from step 1 opens signed in."
8. "The sidebar shows the build under test. ""Update channel"" still shows ""Alpha (Experimental)""."

title: Core daily use works on the installed build
description:
Source flow: REL418-QA-004

A user can sign in, send and receive messages, get and click a notification, download a file, use the tray icon, and quit and reopen with the state kept.
postconditions:
- Screenshots of each step.
- The Log Viewer content, saved to a file, if a step fails.
steps_actions:
1. "Start Rocket.Chat. On the add-workspace screen, type the URL in the field labeled ""Enter your server URL"" and click Connect. Sign in."
2. "Open a direct message with account B. Type a message in the composer at the bottom of the room and press Enter."
3. "Click another app so that Rocket.Chat is not the front window. From a second device, sign in as account B and send a direct message to account A."
4. "Click the notification."
5. "Upload a small file in the room: click the plus button at the left of the composer and select a file. Then click the file in the room to download it."
6. "Press Command+D (macOS) or Ctrl+D (Windows, Linux)."
7. "Find the Rocket.Chat icon on macOS in the menu bar at the top right. On Windows, find it in the notification area at the bottom right. On Linux, find it in the top panel. Click it."
8. "Quit Rocket.Chat. On macOS, click the Rocket.Chat menu at the left of the menu bar, then click Quit Rocket.Chat. On Windows and Linux, click the File menu at the top left of the window, then click Quit Rocket.Chat. Start the app again."
9. "Click the Help menu and click Open Log Viewer."
steps_data:
1. "Workspace URL and account A.
Agent: Take a screenshot."
2. "Account B.
Agent: Take a screenshot."
3. "Text: ""smoke notification"".
Agent: Take a screenshot of the notification."
4. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot."
5. "A text file of less than 1 MB.
Agent: Record the file name."
6. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot of the Downloads window."
7. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot. Existing tray flows: CORE-2525-QA-001 to CORE-2525-QA-013."
8. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot."
9. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot."
steps_results:
1. "The workspace home page shows. A workspace icon shows in the left vertical server list."
2. "The message shows in the room once."
3. "The OS shows a notification with the text. On macOS and Windows, the app icon (Dock or taskbar) shows an unread count."
4. "Rocket.Chat comes to the front and opens the direct message with account B."
5. "The file downloads."
6. "The Downloads window opens and lists the file from step 5 as complete."
7. "A menu opens with the presence options and Quit, or the main window comes to the front."
8. "The main window opens. The workspace opens signed in, on the last room."
9. "The Log Viewer window opens and shows log lines from this session."

title: Store builds check the store and never use the in-app updater
description:
Source flow: REL418-QA-005

On a store build, "Check for updates now" asks the store, shows a result, and the app never downloads an update by itself.
postconditions:
- Screenshots of the check result and the store page.
- The log file.
steps_actions:
1. "Install the store package. mas: install the build from TestFlight. appx: double-click the `.appx` file and click Install. snap: install the `.snap` file."
2. "Press Command+, (macOS) or Ctrl+, (Windows, Linux). In the left sidebar of the App settings window, click General. Find the button labeled ""Check for updates now""."
3. "Click ""Check for updates now""."
4. "If a store button shows, click it."
5. "Click the Help menu and click Open Log Viewer. Search the log for ""electron-updater"" and ""latest""."
steps_data:
1. "`sudo snap install --dangerous ./<file>.snap`.
Agent: Take a screenshot."
2. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot of the General section."
3. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot of the result."
4. "None.
Agent: Take a screenshot."
5. "None.
Agent: Save the log. On mas, the log file is `~/Library/Containers/chat.rocket/Data/Library/Logs/Rocket.Chat/main.log`."
steps_results:
1. "The app starts."
2. "The button shows."
3. "Two results are valid. The app shows ""No updates are available."" Or the app shows ""Version X is available"" with a button. The button opens the store (""Open App Store"", ""Open Microsoft Store"", or ""Open Snap Store""). The app does not start a download."
4. "The store app or the store web page opens on the Rocket.Chat listing."
5. "The log has no electron-updater lines and no request for `latest-mac.yml`, `latest.yml`, or `latest-linux.yml`."

title: Conference links open in the call window on the installed build
description:
Source flow: REL418-QA-020

A conference link opens a separate call window. The main window stays on the workspace after reload and restart.
postconditions:
- Screenshot of the call window at step 3.
- Screenshot of the main window at step 4 and step 6.
steps_actions:
1. "Start the installed Rocket.Chat app. In the left vertical server list, click the three-dots button near the bottom, click `Settings`, and click the `Voice & Video` tab. Find the row `Video calls inside app`."
2. "Close Settings. In the workspace, click a channel in the left room list. Note the room name."
3. "In the message composer, send a message with a conference link. Click the link in the sent message."
4. "Click the main Rocket.Chat window."
5. "Close the call window. In the main window, press `Cmd+R` (macOS) or `Ctrl+R` (Windows, Linux)."
6. "Quit the app fully (`Cmd+Q` on macOS, `File > Quit` on Windows and Linux). Start it again."
steps_data:
1. "Workspace with Pexip, signed in
Agent: Open Settings and read the switch state."
2. "Any channel
Agent: Open a channel and record its name."
3. "`https://<workspace-host>/conference/<alias>?scheduled=true`
Agent: Send the link, click it, and find the new window."
4. "Agent: Capture the main window."
5. "Agent: Close the call window, reload, and capture."
6. "Agent: Quit, relaunch, and capture."
steps_results:
1. "The switch for `Video calls inside app` is on."
2. "A normal room with a message list is open."
3. "A separate call window opens with its own title bar. It shows the meeting screen."
4. "The main window still shows the room from step 2 with the room list on the left. It does not show the meeting screen."
5. "The main window reloads and shows the workspace room list. No call window opens."
6. "The app opens on the workspace, not on the meeting screen. No call window opens."

title: Sign-in popup in the call window opens as an app window and completes
description:
Source flow: REL418-QA-021

The sign-in popup opens as an app window, returns the result to the call, and closes.
postconditions:
- Screenshot at step 3 that shows the popup window and the call window.
- Screenshot of the call window at step 4.
steps_actions:
1. "In the installed app, check that `Video calls inside app` is on: left server list, three-dots button near the bottom, `Settings`, `Voice & Video` tab."
2. "Close Settings. In a room, send a conference link and click it."
3. "In the call window, click the sign-in with SSO control of the meeting page."
4. "Sign in with the test account in the new window."
5. "In the call window, find a link on the meeting page. Middle-click it (or hold `Cmd` on macOS or `Ctrl` on Windows and Linux and click it)."
6. "Close the call window."
steps_data:
1. "Pexip workspace that uses an SSO identity provider
Agent: Read the switch state."
2. "`https://<workspace-host>/conference/<alias>`
Agent: Send and click the link."
3. "Agent: Click the control. Capture all open windows."
4. "SSO test account
Agent: Sign in and capture the call window."
5. "Any http(s) link on the page
Agent: Click with the modifier and check the browser."
6. "Agent: Close the window."
steps_results:
1. "The switch is on."
2. "The call window opens. The meeting page asks the guest to sign in with SSO."
3. "A new window opens with its own title bar, in front of the call window. It shows the identity-provider login page. The system browser does not open."
4. "The new window closes by itself. The call window shows the meeting as signed in."
5. "The link opens in the default system browser. No new app window opens."
6. "The call window closes. The main window stays the same."

title: Call window boots without console errors and keeps a minimal bridge
description:
Source flow: REL418-QA-022

The call page logs no TypeError and no script error. The bridge has no credential method.
postconditions:
- Screenshot of the DevTools console at step 3.
- Copied output of steps 4 and 5.
steps_actions:
1. "In the menu bar open `Help`, then `Video Call Tools`, then click `Auto-open DevTools` to add a check mark. On Windows and Linux, press `Alt` to show a hidden menu bar."
2. "In a room, send a conference link and click it."
3. "In the DevTools window, click the `Console` tab. Read all red entries."
4. "In the console prompt, type `Object.keys(window.RocketChatDesktop.videoCall)` and press Enter."
5. "Type `typeof window.videoCallWindow` and press Enter. Then type `typeof window.RocketChatDesktop.videoCall.getAuthCredentials` and press Enter."
6. "Type `window.RocketChatDesktop.videoCall.openInMainWindow('/home')` and press Enter."
7. "Open the call window again with the same link. In the console, type `window.RocketChatDesktop.videoCall.close()` and press Enter."
8. "In the menu bar open `Help`, `Video Call Tools`, and click `Auto-open DevTools` to clear the check mark."
steps_data:
1. "Agent: Open the menu and toggle the item."
2. "`https://<workspace-host>/conference/new?rid=GENERAL`
Agent: Send and click the link."
3. "Agent: Read the console text and search for these strings."
4. "Agent: Run the command and copy the output."
5. "Agent: Run both commands and copy the output."
6. "Agent: Run the command. Capture the main window."
7. "Agent: Run the command and check that the window closes."
8. "Agent: Toggle the item."
steps_results:
1. "`Auto-open DevTools` shows a check mark."
2. "A call window opens. A DevTools window opens next to it."
3. "The console shows no `TypeError`. It shows no `setUrlResolver is not a function`, no `setUserPresenceDetection is not a function`, no `Error loading Jitsi Meet External API script`, and no `Refused to execute script`."
4. "The result shows `close`, `openInMainWindow`, and `requestScreenSharing`."
5. "Both results show `""undefined""`."
6. "The main window comes to the front on the `/home` page of the workspace. The call window closes or stays, with no error in the console."
7. "The call window closes."
8. "The check mark is gone."

title: Screen sharing from a call still works
description:
Source flow: REL418-QA-023

The picker lists sources and the other participant sees the shared content.
postconditions:
- Screenshot of the picker at step 2.
- Screenshot or answer from the second participant at step 4.
steps_actions:
1. "Start a call from a conference link in a room so that the call window opens. Ask a second person to join the same call on another device."
2. "In the call window, click the screen share control of the meeting toolbar. If the system asks for Screen Recording or screen access, allow it. On macOS, quit and reopen the app after you allow it, and start again from step 1."
3. "In the picker, select a screen thumbnail on the `Your entire screen` tab. Click `Share`."
4. "Ask the second participant what they see."
5. "Stop sharing with the share control of the meeting toolbar. Repeat steps 2 and 3 with the `Application window` tab and one window."
steps_data:
1. "`https://<workspace-host>/conference/<alias>`
Agent: Open the call window."
2. "Agent: Click the share control. Capture the picker."
3. "Agent: Select a source and click Share."
4. "Agent: Get the answer or a screenshot."
5. "One open application window
Agent: Repeat with a window source."
steps_results:
1. "The call window shows the meeting. The second participant is in the call."
2. "A picker window opens with the title `Share your screen`. It has the tabs `Your entire screen` and `Application window`, and the buttons `Cancel` and `Share`."
3. "The picker closes. The call shows that you share your screen."
4. "The second participant sees your screen."
5. "The shared window shows for the second participant. After you stop, the share ends."

title: macOS asks for Screen Recording only when the user shares
description:
Source flow: REL418-QA-024

Launch shows no Screen Recording prompt. The first share request shows it.
postconditions:
- Screenshot of the screen at step 3 and step 4 (no dialog. Step 4 is on `dmg` and `pkg` only).
- Output of step 5.
- Screenshot of the dialog at step 6.
steps_actions:
1. "Quit Rocket.Chat. Open Terminal and run the command in the test data. The command clears the Screen Recording record of the app."
2. "In Terminal, run the command in the test data to note the log size before launch."
3. "Open Rocket.Chat from the Applications folder. The app must have at least one signed-in workspace. Wait 30 seconds."
4. "Run this step on `dmg` and `pkg` only. The Mac App Store build has no in-app call window, and calls open in the browser. On `mas`, go to step 5. Click a conference link in a room so that the call window opens. Wait 10 seconds."
5. "In Terminal, run the log check in the test data."
6. "On `dmg` and `pkg`, click the screen share control of the meeting toolbar in the call window. On `mas`, there is no call window, so open the workspace DevTools (`View`, `Open DevTools`, or `Cmd+Option+I`). Click the `Console` tab, type `navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({video: true})`, and press Enter."
7. "Allow the access in the macOS dialog, or open System Settings, `Privacy & Security`, `Screen & System Audio Recording`, and switch on `Rocket.Chat`. Quit and reopen Rocket.Chat. Share again."
steps_data:
1. "`tccutil reset ScreenCapture chat.rocket`
Agent: Run the command and copy the output."
2. "`wc -l ~/Library/Logs/Rocket.Chat/main.log` (`dmg`, `pkg`) or `wc -l ~/Library/Containers/chat.rocket/Data/Library/Logs/Rocket.Chat/main.log` (`mas`)
Agent: Run the command and store the number."
3. "Agent: Launch and capture the whole screen."
4. "`https://<workspace-host>/conference/<alias>`
Agent: Click the link and capture the screen."
5. "`tail -n +<count from step 2> <log path>`
Agent: Run the command and search the output."
6. "Agent: Click the control or run the command. Capture the screen."
7. "Agent: Grant the access, relaunch, and capture."
steps_results:
1. "The command prints `Successfully reset ScreenCapture approval status for chat.rocket`."
2. "A line count shows. Note it."
3. "The app opens on the workspace. No macOS dialog about Screen Recording appears."
4. "The call window opens. No macOS dialog about Screen Recording appears."
5. "The output has no line with `Failed to get sources`."
6. "A macOS dialog asks to allow Rocket.Chat to record the screen. Or the picker shows the red box `Screen Recording Permission Denied`."
7. "The picker lists screens. On the next launch, no macOS dialog appears."

title: macOS picker shows the reset hint when the grant does not apply
description:
Source flow: REL418-QA-025

The macOS picker shows the extra line about the minus button. Windows and Linux do not.
postconditions:
- Screenshot of the red box at step 3 and step 4.
- Screenshot of the System Settings list before and after step 5.
steps_actions:
1. "Install the `dmg` build, start it, open a call, and share the screen once. Allow access when macOS asks. Quit the app."
2. "Install the `mas` build (TestFlight) over the `dmg` build. Start it. The Mac App Store build has no in-app call window, so open the workspace DevTools: `View`, `Open DevTools` (`Cmd+Option+I`). Click the `Console` tab."
3. "On `mas`, type `navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({video: true})` in the console and press Enter. The workspace window then shows the picker."
4. "Read the last line of the red box."
5. "Click `Open System Preferences`. In the list, select `Rocket.Chat` and click the minus (−) button below the list. Quit Rocket.Chat and start it again."
6. "Run the same `getDisplayMedia` command in the DevTools console again, as in step 3. Click `Allow` in the macOS dialog."
7. "For a quick platform check, open the picker on Windows or Linux with screen access denied, if you can."
steps_data:
1. "`dmg` build, signed-in workspace
Agent: Install, share, and capture the list."
2. "`mas` build
Agent: Install, start, and open DevTools."
3. "Agent: Run the command and capture the picker."
4. "Agent: Capture the box and compare the text."
5. "Agent: Follow the text and capture the list."
6. "Agent: Share and capture the picker."
7. "Windows or Linux build
Agent: Capture the picker if it shows."
steps_results:
1. "Sharing works. System Settings, `Screen & System Audio Recording` lists `Rocket.Chat` as on."
2. "The DevTools window shows the `Console` tab."
3. "The picker opens with the title `Share your screen`. A red box with the title `Screen Recording Permission Denied` fills the body. It says `Screen recording permission is required to share your screen.` and has the link `Open System Preferences`."
4. "The last line reads `Already turned on? Select Rocket.Chat in that list, remove it with the minus (−) button, and quit and reopen Rocket.Chat. Then share your screen again and allow access when macOS asks.`"
5. "System Settings opens on the Screen Recording list. The entry is gone."
6. "The picker lists screens and sharing works."
7. "The hint line does not appear. On Linux and Windows the red box can be absent when no permission is required."

title: A hung workspace shows the failure view and Reload recovers it
description:
Source flow: REL418-QA-030

A workspace page that is stuck in a loop is replaced by the "Server Failed to Load" view within about 30 seconds, and Reload (button or countdown) loads a working page.
postconditions:
